secondary.description: two-sided cold-to-cold DDI ranking, evaluated in both directions

reproducibility.G0: Original saved rank vectors reproduced exactly for all three model seeds in both evaluations.
reproducibility.G3: Original saved rank vectors did not reproduce from the preserved checkpoints and frozen G3 graph. Validated results therefore use fresh canonical checkpoint-based evaluation.

interpretation_constraints: This is DDI-edge cold-start, not fully inductive unseen-node evaluation.
Cold drugs remain represented as graph nodes with learned node embeddings.
G3 retains non-DDI biomedical edges for cold drugs.
The cold cohort is fixed using split seed 42.
Model seeds 42, 43, and 44 measure model variation conditional on this single fixed cohort.
Cold-cohort eligibility used total DDI degree and existing test DDI degree, so cohort construction is not test-blind.
No statistical significance claim is made from three model seeds.
